name: Emily
source:
Emily is the Human Resources manager at Roy's firm and his main target for corruption. 

She is a lesbian and she has just broken up with her long time girlfriend Trisha. 

Feeling a bit lost and confused, she invites Roy over to her place to have a few drinks. 

Roy thinks that Emily has great potential to be molded to his liking and decides to target Emily during this period of weakness for her.

Emily also has a 38 year old sister and her sister is married. Her sister had two 21 year old boys with her husband.
